1479-2841-8105-8338.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Escape Tunnel.
1479-2841-8105-8338.description:
Fetch a land using Escape Tunnel.
When the fetched land enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1418-1651-2638-6756-8344.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1418-1651-2638-6756-8344.notablePrerequisites:
Nog's second activated ability has been activated.
Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1418-1651-2638-6756-8344.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker triggers twice due to Virtue of Knowledge, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

4247-4381-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4247-4381-4694-7306.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

967-3809-4247-6441-7087.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1170-2829-5131-7753--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2829-5131-7753--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Valeria Richards.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Ravager
Repeat.

as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3455-7936.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3455-7936.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Dominion Saboteur and Vizier of Many Faces each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Dominion Saboteur trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Vizier of Many Faces trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3455-7936.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

997-1580-4871-6026.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Field of Souls trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1355-4644-7791.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two enchantments.
1355-4644-7791.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Sanctum Weaver.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Sanctum Weaver.
Repeat.

1768-2438--5.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Juniper Order Ranger triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and Juniper Order Ranger.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat

7439-7442.description:
Cast a copy of Channel by paying {G}{G}.
Activate the ability granted by Channel by paying 1 life, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 as desired.
Cast Torment of Hailfire by paying {B}{B} and all remaining available mana. Each opponent will lose 3 life unless they sacrifice a nonland permanent or discard a card for each mana paid beyond the {B}{B}.
7439-7442.notes: The more life you have, the more life your opponents will lose. You can also add mana as desired from other sources to cast Torment of Hailfire. While the opponents can sacrifice permanents and/or discard cards to prevent lifeloss, they'll eventually run out of cards/permanents if enough mana is poured into Torment of Hailfire.

856-4321-6797-7422.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-4321-6797-7422.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Garrison Excavator trigger.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

2060-2325-3525-6996.easyPrerequisites:
Soulmender does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Soulmender.
2060-2325-3525-6996.description:
Activate Soulmender by tapping it, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's ability by paying {U}, untapping Soulmender.
Repeat.

891-1052-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1020-2866-2906-4659.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost life this turn.
1020-2866-2906-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Rakdos.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Rakdos.
Repeat.

3809-4682-5140-6441.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
3809-4682-5140-6441.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create two Treasure tokens due to Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}{U} due to Goldspan Dragon.
Repeat.
3809-4682-5140-6441.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

2366-4974-5223-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-4974-5223-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zendikar Resurgent triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

341-2034-5224-6294.description:
Cast Marketback Walker by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Marketback Walker.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Marketback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Marketback Walker dies, it and Together Forever trigger.
Resolve the Marketback Walker trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Together Forever trigger, returning Marketback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2757-4222-6859.description:
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Servant of Tymaret, untapping the Island.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Servant of Tymaret.
Servant of Tymaret triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain that much life.
Repeat.

3334-3693-4613-6843.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Lae'zel.
Activate Anti-Venom using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2034-2811-3000-4593.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Elas il-Kor's first ability triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the creature tokens die, Elas il-Kor's second ability triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Repeat.
2034-2811-3000-4593.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

3609-4772-6750.notablePrerequisites: Inspirit has one or more charge counters on it.
3609-4772-6750.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Inspirit triggers, putting four charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

325-2498-6282.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
325-2498-6282.notablePrerequisites: You have more cards in hand than your maximum hand size.
325-2498-6282.description:
Move to your cleanup step, causing you to discard cards down to your maximum hand size.
Toluz's second ability triggers for each card discarded.
Resolve the first trigger, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Sheoldred triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2 if needed for each remaining trigger.
Discard down to your maximum hand size again, as you are still in your cleanup step.
Repeat.

1003-2538-3676-6193.description:
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Tangleroot triggers, adding {G}.
When Phyrexian Walker enters the battlefield, Soul of the Harvest triggers.
Holding priority, activate Words of Wind by paying {1}, replacing the next card you draw.
Resolve the Soul of the Harvest trigger, causing you to return Phyrexian Walker from the battlefield to your hand, and causing each opponent to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1458-4131-5864.notablePrerequisites: You control a Bird, Rat, Otter and/or Frog that does not have summoning sickness.
1458-4131-5864.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting a Bird, Rat, Otter and/or Frog you control that does not have summoning sickness.
Valley Floodcaller triggers, giving Birds, Otters, Frogs and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Resolve Banishing Knack.
Cast Basalt Monolith by paying its mana cost.
Valley Floodcaller triggers, giving Birds, Otters, Frogs and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate the creature targeted by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning Basalt Monolith from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 4.

4067-5796-5797.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
You have sacrificed a Food this turn, or at least three cards have left your graveyard this turn.
Bonecache Overseer does not have summoning sickness.
Your life total is at least 2.
4067-5796-5797.description:
Activate Bonecache Overseer by tapping it and paying 1 life, causing you to draw a card.
Starving Revenant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Bonecache Overseer.
Repeat.

380-703-4772.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Miirym.
Resolve the Astral Dragon trigger, creating four token copies of Doubling Season that are 3/3 Dragons in addition to their other types.
Resolve the Miirym trigger, creating a total of 32 Astral Dragon tokens.
The Astral Dragon tokens enter the battlefield, creating an extremely large number of Doubling Season tokens that are 3/3 Dragons in addition to their other types.

1681-4140-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Twilight Shepherd.
When Twilight Shepherd dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Giada.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

579-654-2893-4500.notablePrerequisites: Fertilid has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
579-654-2893-4500.description:
Activate Fertilid, searching your library for a basic Forest card, putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the land.
Retreat to Kazandu triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter Fertilid.
Tap the land for {G}{G}.
Repeat.

2560-3059-3231.description:
Cast Chandra's Ignition by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing Malignus to deal damage equal to twice its power to each other creature and each opponent.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
